gate_catalog.api-absence: A checked-in test proves a deliberately excluded or retired surface stays absent and is not reported as product acceptance.
gate_catalog.api-decision: A checked-in support-matrix or decision contract names the replacement or retirement before feature work proceeds.
gate_catalog.commit-replay: Typed commit tests cover canonical identity, exact replay, conflict, response loss, and current commit-head authority.
gate_catalog.cursor-differential: Opaque cursor tests cover progress, scope binding, wrong-scope and stale rejection, and pre/current semantic differences.
gate_catalog.facade-contract: Transport-free nokv-agent tests assert the stable Workbench request, result, and typed error behavior.
gate_catalog.lingtai-mcp-e2e: The real LingTai MCPClient registers and calls the release-identity NoKV process through stdio, including restart and reconnect.
gate_catalog.native-workbench-e2e: The real NoKV client, server, metadata store, and object backend execute the Workbench behavior end to end.
gate_catalog.output-golden: A versioned golden transcript freezes supported result and error projections without inode, dentry, or filesystem fields.
gate_catalog.provider-recovery: Real provider and process gates cover publication, restart, response loss, cleanup, reference-fenced GC, and exact bytes.
gate_catalog.python-sdk-e2e: The supported path-native Python SDK or explicit materialize/collect adapter is tested against real NoKV services.
gate_catalog.restore-composition: A committed source can be snapshotted, restored, snapshotted again, and restored again with exact replay and independent bytes.
gate_catalog.root-authority-e2e: Two persisted Agent-to-RootId bindings prove isolation; changing a presentation path alone never claims storage isolation.
gate_catalog.schema-surface: The exact 18 tool names and closed normalized input schemas are checked against the Rust-owned frozen schema.
gate_catalog.snapshot-lifecycle: Typed snapshot tests cover frozen reads, renew, retire, reap, foreign identity, HistoryHold, and reference release.

items.boundary: workbench_create MCP schema, facade, and result
items.requirement: Create one named Workbench and return its stable logical identity and three virtual sections.

items.boundary: workbench_put_file facade to create-only or replace-only publication
items.requirement: Publish exact text or base64 bytes with create/replace semantics, including an absent-Workbench call, without restoring inode output.

items.boundary: workbench_append facade to atomic append workflow
items.requirement: Append atomically, create an absent file and Workbench, and report delta, resulting size, generation, and digest.

items.boundary: workbench_edit facade mutation and retry semantics
items.requirement: Edit exact UTF-8 text once or globally, preserve no-op generations, and revalidate conflicts before retry.

items.boundary: workbench_list scope normalization and typed pagination
items.requirement: List live or frozen Workbench scope with opaque pagination; explicit empty path selects the same root as an omitted path.

items.boundary: workbench_stat scope normalization and metadata-only lookup
items.requirement: Return live or frozen metadata without fetching object bytes; explicit empty path selects the root.

items.boundary: workbench_read range, conditional, structured, and snapshot reads
items.requirement: Read exact bytes as text, base64, or structured pages with ranges, if-none-match, frozen views, and progress cursors.

items.boundary: workbench_grep scope, file scan, and result cursor
items.requirement: Run ASCII case-insensitive literal OR grep with glob filtering, including empty-root scope and stable result pagination.

items.boundary: workbench_search scoped indexed query and cursor
items.requirement: Search optional Workbench scope with predicates, fields, facets, sort, and a scope-bound cursor; missing roots return defined empty results.

items.boundary: workbench_aggregate scoped typed query
items.requirement: Aggregate optional Workbench scope with predicates, measures, groups, sorting, limits, and empty-root equivalence.

items.boundary: workbench_catalog scoped field discovery
items.requirement: Describe fields, filters, sort and facets for optional scope, including explicit empty path and defined empty catalogs.

items.boundary: workbench_find global Workbench discovery
items.requirement: Filter committed state and manifest content with ASCII case-insensitive matching, stable pagination, and optional full manifest output.

items.boundary: workbench_commit canonical provenance workflow
items.requirement: Commit valid canonical provenance with stable identity and exact replay, including an absent Workbench, without inode-shaped output.

items.boundary: workbench_snapshot admission and leased read-version creation
items.requirement: Snapshot any committed Workbench, including a restored destination, with validated alias, TTL, reason, metadata, and warnings.

items.boundary: workbench_snapshot_renew lifecycle transition
items.requirement: Resolve a snapshot by id or alias and atomically extend its lease without changing frozen content.

items.boundary: workbench_snapshot_retire lifecycle transition
items.requirement: Resolve and retire a snapshot with typed terminal and idempotent replay behavior.

items.boundary: workbench_snapshot_list public result projection
items.requirement: Keep snapshot lifecycle discoverable through the versioned current snapshot_count/snapshots projection; do not recreate checkpoints.jsonl or legacy checkpoint keys implicitly.

items.boundary: workbench_restore staged COW lifecycle and result
items.requirement: Restore a frozen source into an independent destination with cleanup, exact terminal replay, destination-owned committed provenance, and no physical root projection.

items.boundary: complete Workbench MCP surface
items.requirement: Expose exactly 18 Workbench tools with restore capability-gated and no silent extras or omissions.

items.boundary: closed JSON input schemas and typed invalid arguments
items.requirement: Reject unknown keys and invalid required, scalar, enum, and bound values through the stable typed error envelope.

items.boundary: Workbench id, virtual section, and normalized relative-path admission
items.requirement: Enforce id grammar, the three virtual sections, and traversal and absolute-path jail through one storage-neutral normalizer.

items.boundary: implicit Workbench create within mutation admission
items.requirement: Put, append, and commit against an absent id establish the same path-native Workbench exactly once and remain replay-safe under races.

items.boundary: optional Workbench scope parsing
items.requirement: For optional-scope tools, path set to the empty string is equivalent to an omitted path at Workbench or section root.

items.boundary: durable Agent-to-RootId authority and root placement
items.requirement: Identical Workbench ids owned by different agents cannot read, list, find, mutate, snapshot, or restore across their persisted RootIds; display roots are not authority.

items.boundary: Workbench payload admission
items.requirement: Accept exactly one text or base64 payload, preserve or default content type, and enforce decode and size limits with typed errors.

items.boundary: conditional immutable publication
items.requirement: Keep put create-only and replace-only distinct, return generation and digest, and reject the opposite precondition.

items.boundary: atomic append and generation conflict handling
items.requirement: Append creates an absent file, prevents lost updates under two writers, and reports exact delta and result state.

items.boundary: edit revalidation and no-op semantics
items.requirement: Edit performs exact UTF-8 matching, one or all replacements, no-op without generation change, and conflict-safe revalidation.

items.boundary: opaque scope cursor and Workbench revision fence
items.requirement: Every pageable operation progresses without duplication or skipping, rejects wrong scope, and uses current revision authority rather than restoring naked offsets.

items.boundary: metadata stat and immutable object read
items.requirement: Keep stat metadata-only and preserve ranges, formats, conditional reads, frozen reads, and total and generation metadata.

items.boundary: grep pattern normalization and scoped file scan
items.requirement: Grep remains ASCII case-insensitive literal OR matching, not regex, with bounded alternatives and glob semantics.

items.boundary: search, aggregate, and catalog query semantics
items.requirement: Queries honor id, section and path scope, typed predicates and result controls, and return defined empty output for a missing root.

items.boundary: global manifest discovery
items.requirement: Find filters committed state and manifest content case-insensitively, paginates, and projects optional manifest data consistently.

items.boundary: commit provenance, identity, and terminal replay
items.requirement: Validate and canonicalize run provenance, preserve stable commit identity, distinguish replace conflicts, and reconcile outcome-unknown retries.

items.boundary: snapshot admission and lease policy
items.requirement: Require committed provenance and enforce alias, default and maximum TTL, annotations, metadata, and warning behavior.

items.boundary: typed snapshot identity, state, and public projection
items.requirement: Renew, list and retire by snapshot id or alias with typed lifecycle states and terminal replay, using current snapshot output rather than checkpoints.jsonl.

items.boundary: leased MVCC snapshot and HistoryHold
items.requirement: Snapshot reads remain frozen after live mutation; renew preserves content and retired, reaped, expired, or foreign snapshots fail loudly.

items.boundary: staged COW restore, publication, cleanup, and replay
items.requirement: Validate source, destination and snapshot, hide staging, preserve source bytes, publish a COW destination, clean safely, and replay the same terminal result.

items.boundary: destination-owned committed provenance after restore
items.requirement: A restored destination is committed and independently composable through restore to snapshot to restore without copying stale source identity.

items.boundary: generic seven-tool Agent MCP profile
items.requirement: Record that the generic profile is replaced by the explicit 18-tool Workbench adapter unless a separate support decision restores it.

items.boundary: old Rust filesystem SDK
items.requirement: Replace supported client outcomes with RootId-routed WorkspaceClient tests; inode, dentry, and raw filesystem types are not current acceptance.

items.boundary: old Python client and range batch API
items.requirement: Map supported byte, range, retry, and concurrency outcomes onto the current path-native Python Client or explicitly retire each unmapped type.

items.boundary: generic fsspec filesystem adapter
items.requirement: Keep generic fsspec absent from the product graph and retain an explicit absence and support-matrix contract.

items.boundary: Python checkpoint publish, commit, and load helpers
items.requirement: Route retained checkpoint outcomes through current commit, snapshot, materialize, and collect contracts after an explicit API decision.

items.boundary: torch.distributed.checkpoint integration
items.requirement: Decide the adapter boundary first; if supported, test it over current immutable publication and explicit materialize or collect rather than filesystem emulation.

items.boundary: FUSE and POSIX filesystem frontend
items.requirement: Keep FUSE, POSIX emulation, inode and dentry acceptance outside the NoKV product architecture.

items.boundary: old filesystem and administration command surface
items.requirement: Map retained Workbench and operational outcomes to the current CLI and explicitly decide backup, restore, fsck, GC, and other unmapped commands without filesystem compatibility shims.
